info.album: Send Me An Angel - '80s Synth Essentials

podcast.body: This 1983 song by Australian band Real Life is a notable example of early electronic drumming. The recording features exclusively electronic drum sounds, with no acoustic drums whatsoever, all played on a Simmons electronic kit by drummer Danny Simzick. "From 1983 that's Australia's real life with Send Me an Angel."
